source: STRUCTURE of one real 2228-entry conversation journal - the operator's SECOND report of the 'I can't scroll past that' class, whose red failure row came from the lost-race half rather than from a broken paging path. Every number here was measured off that journal and is a COUNT, a POSITION or a TYPE: no text, ids or timestamps were copied, and the entries between the measured positions are deterministic filler minted from `filler` below.
grammar: custom:<custom_type> | message:<custom_type> (a message-typed custom row) | user | assistant:<tool_calls>:<has_text 0|1> | tool | prune | compaction | compaction:<rows_back> (a durable compaction row whose `first_kept_entry_id` names the entry that many rows earlier in the journal). Consumed by scripts/loader-journal-fixture.mjs, which mints synthetic ids, instants and text.
